enforcedRules: Grammar and generated sources update atomically with a new engine version
New model classes declare parser construction and snapshot projection tests
Engine cannot depend on browsers, desktop UI, AIDC CLI/core or RuntimeServer
Origin and upstream synchronization history remain auditable
Runtime, engine and schema versions are exposed independently

verification.name: SysML browser
verification.command: npm --workspace aidc-sysml-browser run test && npm --workspace aidc-sysml-browser run build

verification.name: portable package build and launch
verification.command: npm run build:distribution:p2 && npm run verify:distribution:p2
